title: topmind Tool Contract (v3.4 — categories + topics)
description: Single source of truth for a topmind workspace tool. Uses category + topic naming.

kind.description: Unique tool identifier, e.g. 'workspace-read'. Kind names are stable internal identifiers; command names follow the topic-and-category vocabulary.

skill.description: Owning tool domain. The 8 kinds are stable internal identifiers; they are NOT project-type labels.

cwd_mode.description: engine_root = invoke from engine root; topic_root = invoke with cwd set to {category}/{topic}/

script.description: Relative script path from engine root

args_template.description: Base CLI args with {variable} placeholders. Available variables: {engine_root}, {workspace_root}, {categories_root}, {inbox_root}, {archive_root}, {category_root}, {topic_root}, {category}, {topic}, {command}, {mode}, {source_path}, {receipt_path}, plus any input field name.

commands.description: Map of command name -> command definition. Current surface (25): list-categories, list-topics, inspect-topic, list-topic-files, list-inbox, list-recent-captures, list-safety-receipts, create-topic, capture-note, save-output, update-topic, normalize-note-metadata, plan-inbox-routing, migrate-v4, doctor-workspace, archive-topic, restore-safety-receipt, cleanup-empty-dirs, validate, promote, digest, append-profile, append-topic, scan, rebuild.

requires_topic.description: True if the command needs (category, topic) inputs. False if the command operates at the category level only (e.g. list-categories, list-topics) or workspace level (e.g. doctor-workspace, plan-inbox-routing).

inputs.description: Per-field input definitions keyed by camelCase field name

type.description: v3.4 input types: category (大类目录名, e.g. '20-研究'), topic (专题目录名, e.g. '2026-示例记录'), category-and-topic (paired object), path (workspace-relative path).

args_extra.description: Per-command extra args appended after base template. Supports {field}, {category}, {topic}, {category_root}, {topic_root} variables.

reads.description: Glob patterns for files read by this command. Patterns: 00-收件箱/**, {category}/** (category-scoped), {category}/{topic}/** (topic-scoped), {category}/*.md (loose notes), 88-输出/** (deliveries), 99-归档/** (recovery), memory/** (semantic plane).

writes.description: Glob patterns for files written by this command. Patterns: 00-收件箱/**, {category}/** (loose note creation), {category}/{topic}/*.md (topic notes), {category}/{topic}/topic.md (topic home), 88-输出/** (deliveries), 99-归档/** (backups), memory/** (semantic plane).

preview_strategy.description: Per-command preview instructions used by the confirm-mode review phase

review_overrides.description: Per-command review overrides for confirmation copy and preview strategy
